    Critical unit forms are nonnegative with a sincere radical #

    For a critical unit form q in at least three variables:

    • a sincere z ≫ 0 with q(z) ≤ 0 and Σ z minimal is a radical vector: q(z - e_a) ≥ 1 gives B(z, e_a) ≤ q(z), and summing gives q(z) = 0 and B(z, e_a) = 0 (exists_sincere_radical);
    • q is nonnegative, and q(x) = 0 only for rational multiples of z: compare x with z_{a₀} x - x_{a₀} z, which is ≥ 0 and vanishes at a₀ for a₀ minimizing x_a / z_a (nonneg_of_radical).

    This is the elementary part of Ovsienko's theorem (von Höhne 1988, §1).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.B_sub_right {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (x y y' : ι → ℤ) :
    q.B x (y - y') = q.B x y - q.B x y'

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.B_single_right {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (x : ι → ℤ) (a : ι) :
    q.B x (Pi.single a 1) = ∑ b : ι, q.c b a * x b
    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.B_eq_sum_single {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (z x : ι → ℤ) :
    q.B z x = ∑ a : ι, x a * q.B z (Pi.single a 1)

    B(z, x) = Σ_a x_a B(z, e_a).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.val_sub_single {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (z : ι → ℤ) (a : ι) :
    q.val (z - Pi.single a 1) = q.val z - q.B z (Pi.single a 1) + 1

    2 q(z - e_a) = 2 q(z) - 2 B(z, e_a) + 2.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.Critical.exists_sincere {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (hq : q.Critical) :
    ∃ (z : ι → ℤ), (∀ (a : ι), 0 < z a) ∧ q.val z ≤ 0

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.Critical.exists_sincere_radical {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (hq : q.Critical) (hn : 3 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ (z : ι → ℤ), (∀ (a : ι), 0 < z a) ∧ ∀ (x : ι → ℤ), q.B z x = 0

    A critical form in at least three variables has a sincere radical vector.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.val_smul_add_radical {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (z : ι → ℤ) (hz : ∀ (x : ι → ℤ), q.B z x = 0) (s t : ℤ) (x : ι → ℤ) :
    q.val (s • x + t • z) = s ^ 2 * q.val x

    q(s x + t z) = s² q(x) for a radical vector z.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.nonneg_of_radical {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) [Nonempty ι] (z : ι → ℤ) (hz : ∀ (a : ι), 0 < z a) (hrad : ∀ (x : ι → ℤ), q.B z x = 0) (hoff : ∀ (a : ι), q.WeaklyPositiveOff a) (x : ι → ℤ) :
    0 ≤ q.val x ∧ (q.val x = 0 → ∃ (a : ι), z a • x = x a • z)

    Nonnegativity: a form with a sincere positive radical vector, weakly positive off each index, is nonnegative, and vanishes only on rational multiples of the radical vector.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.Forms.UnitForm.Critical.nonneg {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (q : UnitForm ι) (hq : q.Critical) (hn : 3 ≤ Fintype.card ι) :
    ∃ (z : ι → ℤ), (∀ (a : ι), 0 < z a) ∧ (∀ (x : ι → ℤ), q.B z x = 0) ∧ ∀ (x : ι → ℤ), 0 ≤ q.val x ∧ (q.val x = 0 → ∃ (a : ι), z a • x = x a • z)

    Critical forms are nonnegative (in at least three variables), with a sincere positive radical vector z spanning the rational radical.
